name: Named sources and masked recipients in Korean shift handoffs

cases.prompt: 아래 기록으로 다음 교대에 넘길 한국어 인수인계 메모를 작성해 주세요.

checks.criterion: Compare OPS-417 with the handoff. Can the incoming shift tell that 민서 reported the queue delay had cleared at 17:40 and 진우 reported it persisted at the same time, with the conflict unresolved? Quote the wording that attributes the accounts. Anonymous aliases, reversed speakers, a separate list of unassigned names, or declaring a winner fail. Accept an unambiguous paraphrase in either order.

cases.prompt: 아래 기록으로 다음 교대에 넘길 한국어 인수인계 메모를 작성해 주세요.

checks.criterion: Compare DB-092 with the handoff. After comparing snapshots, the shift must notify both the team at db-front@example.org and 대호 via the masked personal address by Friday noon. Quote the routing instructions. Can a reader identify both destinations and which person should receive the private copy? Fail if 대호 appears only as a DB-086 reporter, the mask is tied to someone else, the personal address is disclosed, or a recipient is assigned the work without support. Accept equivalent phrasing, layout and address order.
